subject: Weekly exec quickline: wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly exec quickline: wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks

Team — attaching a compact readout for this week as we tighten QBR materials. TL;DR: solid delivery on infra latency work, two commercial risks (Acme procurement and a SOC evidence gap), and three concrete asks below.

Wins
- Serving runtime perf: 95th p95 latency improved by ~18% after kernel tuning (see QBR_Prep_Slides_v2.pdf, slide 3).
- Dedication playbook: Completed smoke tests for Dedicated pool A; handoff to SRE tomorrow.

Risks / Chokepoints
1) Acme renewal: procurement asked for a revised SOW and a custom data-retention clause. Legal needs a final SOW version; Acme wants signatures this week to hit their fiscal close. (Related: Acme_SOW_Draft.docx)
2) Security evidence: customer-facing SOC control evidence for network isolation is incomplete — Security asked for an audit log export format by EOD Wed. Without this, some enterprise prospects may delay purchasing.

Asks (actionable)
- Laura: Can you confirm priority items for the board QBR one-pager? I suggest we emphasize cost-per-token improvements and Dedicated capacity readiness. Deadline Tue 11:00am.
- Jonas: Please prioritize the SOC log export task with Security and SRE; can you own coordinating that and loop in Marissa? Deadline Wed EOD.
- Marissa: Prep the Acme redline summary and proposed SOW edits; share with Kimberly + Legal by Tue 5pm so we can push DocuSign.

Attachments: QBR_Prep_Slides_v2.pdf, OKR-heatmap-July.csv, Acme_SOW_Draft.docx

Thanks — short replies appreciated if you see blockers.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec quickline: wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks

Kimberly — thanks for the concise readout. Agree on the one-pager focus: highlight the latency win, capacity readiness, and the cost optimization levers. Two quick notes:
- Board will want a short customer example showing end-to-end impact; can we add a one-slide Acme case (before/after latency + projected $ savings)?
- I'm okay to be the voice on the one-pager; please send the slide(s) by Tue 9am so I can weave into the pack.

Laura
Laura Bennett | VP Product

On the Acme SOW: I'm finishing a redline summary now and will send to Kimberly + Legal by Tue 5pm as requested. Also flagged one commercial ask from Acme (shorter data-retention window) — I'll propose a compromise clause.

Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec quickline: wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks — brief status update

Quick status update to close the loop this week: 
- SOC export: Jonas ran the Wed sync; Marissa delivered sample CSV by 5pm Wed and Security validated format Thurs AM. Action: SRE to push a one-time export endpoint by next Tue.
- Acme SOW: Marissa shared redlines Tue 4:45pm; Legal completed edits Wed noon. Sent DocuSign to Acme Thu 11:00am — DocuSign envelope ID: 0f3a-ACME-779. Acme expects signed SOW by Mon EOD; I'm keeping a short cadence with their procurement lead (sara.white@acme.com).
- QBR slides: Laura incorporated the Acme impact slide and tightened the narrative; pack now at 28 slides. I trimmed non-essential ops detail to keep the exec deck tight.

Open asks for next week:
- Laura: final slide approval by Mon 9am PT so we can send to Board Ops.
- Jonas: confirm SRE rollout schedule for the export endpoint by Tue EOD.
- Vanessa: can you review the one-pager language for channel readiness — one-line feedback by Mon noon?

Thanks everyone for fast turns. If anything slips over the weekend, call me directly.

—Kimberly
